notes: Headline all-items HICP for BG (ECOICOP ver.2, TOTAL, annual rate of change). index_by_year and latest_index are DERIVED, not published as such by Eurostat: index_by_year takes the December reading of each year out of the monthly series (a year without a December is omitted), and both are rebased from Eurostat's published 2015=100 base to 2020=100. The annual rate of change is Eurostat's own figure, unmodified.
